items.prompt: Mid-century modern agricultural poster illustration in the design language of 1960s international rice-extension posters and Pan Am travel prints, crossed with magazine-editorial pacing. Composition uses bold geometric shapes with slightly rounded organic edges, arranged to invisible columns with one dominant focal area and generous calm gutters. Color is applied in four to six flat blocks with no gradients and no anti-aliased softness; light arrives from one side only and becomes a hard-edged shadow block rather than a diffuse falloff. Lines are thick but hand-aware with slight character and a 1px ink misregistration offset. A halftone dot pattern at 12% opacity sits over the large fills and paper grain at 10% opacity covers the whole composition. Depth comes from overlapping flat planes, never from perspective realism or blur. Atmospheric backdrop with no dominant subject. The horizon sits low, at about 55% of the canvas height, so the entire upper region stays a calm flat sky field that will carry an SVG Thai title and a single line of figures. Below the horizon, three overlapping bands of ripe rice panicles recede from the bottom edge toward the horizon, each band a flatter and lighter plane than the one in front of it, the nearest panicles reading as individual bowed heads and the farthest as one continuous silhouette. A single flat circular sun sits just above the horizon at the lower-right third intersection, deliberately away from the title field. A Thai lowland paddy at rest in early morning: bowed ripe rice panicles, flooded field water showing as thin flat slivers between the nearest stems, and low earth bunds crossing the middle plane. No people, no buildings, no machinery, no animals. Composed as a 1280x720px image for hero_page use; the whole sky region above the horizon is the reserved svg overlay region and must stay free of shapes, texture spikes, and the sun. NO text of any kind anywhere in the image — no letters, numbers, Thai or Latin characters, signs, watermarks, labels, or written symbols.
